# The counterparty-risk pack

*Counterparty credit risk* · version 1.0.0 · code `CCR`

## What it is

Counterparty credit risk over the trading pack's trades: master agreements and CSAs, netting sets, credit limits, CVA, SA-CCR,
collateral balances, margin calls and SIMM initial margin, and the **exposure engine's inputs** (2.9.0): an upstream simulation run
(`simulation-run`) and every trade's mark to market on every path of its grid (`exposure-path`). Exposure is never stored: `EXP
NSET:NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA <GO>` (the computed kind `exposure-result`, [EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md Part II](../../../docs/guides/EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md#14-the-contract-at-a-glance)) nets the paths per
netting set, applies each CSA's collateral path by path with the margin period of risk, and reads EE, ENE, EEE, PFE 95% and 99%, EPE
and EEPE for any scope (`NSET:`, `CPTY:`, `GROUP:`, `LE:`, `DESK:`, `TRD:`); the netting-set and counterparty pages show the engine's
figures computed as they open. The stored `exposure-profile` kind (`EXP-<cp>-<le>`) was retired in 2.9.0: `EXP EXP-ALDERSHOT-FRA`
opens `EXP NSET:NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA`. The exposure explorer ([EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md section 3](../../../docs/guides/EXPOSURE_GUIDE.md#3-the-explorer-screen-by-screen))
walks from the bank to a trade; [tutorial 26](../../../docs/tutorials/26-exposure-from-the-bank-to-a-trade.md) does it on the test data.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `agreement`

**Master agreement** · mnemonic `AGR` · read through connector `legal-store`.

**Id:** field `AGREEMENT_ID`; pattern `^AGR-`; for example `AGR-ALDERSHOT-ISDA`.

Fields, from 18 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGREEMENT_ID` | string | `AGR-ALDERSHOT-ISDA` | The document's id |
| `TYPE` | string | `ISDA 2002 Master` | The master agreement form, for example the ISDA 2002 Master Agreement. |
| `COUNTERPARTY_NAME` | string | `Aldershot Pension Trust` | The legal entity that signed the agreement with the bank. |
| `GOVERNING_LAW` | string | `English` | The law the agreement is read under, which decides how close-out netting is enforced. |
| `SIGNED` | date | `2015-12-10` | The date the agreement was signed. |
| `CLOSE_OUT_NETTING` | string | `Enforceable` | Whether a legal opinion confirms that on default the trades net to one amount; only then may exposure be netted. |
| `ELECTIONS` | object |  | The agreement's elections |
| `COUNTERPARTY` | string | `CP-ALDERSHOT` | The counterparty's id; link to `counterparty` |
| `CSA` | string | `CSA-ALDERSHOT` | link to `csa` |

Nested structures:

| Path | Fields |
|---|---|
| `ELECTIONS` | `AUTOMATIC_EARLY_TERMINATION` (boolean): Whether the trades end by themselves on certain defaults, without a notice., `CROSS_DEFAULT` (string): The threshold above which a default on other debt is a default under this agreement., `SET_OFF` (boolean): Whether amounts owed under other contracts may be set off against the close-out amount., `TERMINATION_CURRENCY` (string): The currency the close-out amount is paid in., `ADDITIONAL_TERMINATION_EVENTS` (string): Further events, such as a downgrade, that let a party end the trades., `PROTOCOLS` (string): The ISDA protocols both parties adhered to, which amend the agreement. |

Links: `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `CSA` → `csa`.

| `LEGAL_ENTITY` | string | `LE-FRA` | link to `legal-entity` |
| `DESK` | string | `DESK-SFT` | link to `desk` |
| `TT_BOOK` | string | `BOOK-SFT-1` | link to `book` |
| `ASSET_CLASS` | string | `Securities financing` | — |
| `PRODUCT` | string | `Tri-party repo` | — |
| `NOTIONAL` | number | `260700000.0` | — |
| `MATURITY_DATE` | date | `2027-02-15` | — |
| `GRID_INDEX` | integer | `0` | Index into the run's GRID_DATES |
| `GRID_DATE` | date | `2026-10-07` | The future date the values are for. |
| `MTM` | list of integers |  | P values, path order of the run, stored as a list<double> column (out of the document) |
| `STATUS` | string | `ok` | ok, proxied (an approximate model) or failed (no values). |
| `PRICER` | string | `testgen-factor-walk` | — |
| `BATCH_ID` | string | `XB-2026-09-30-01` | — |

Links: `COUNTERPARTY` → `counterparty`, `DESK` → `desk`, `LEGAL_ENTITY` → `legal-entity`, `NETTING_SET` → `netting-set`, `RUN_ID` → `simulation-run`, `TRADE_ID` → `trade`, `TT_BOOK` → `book`.

### `exposure-result`

| `BY_NETTING_SET[].PFE_CONTRIBUTION` | Share of the peak PFE |
| `CANONICAL` | Scope |
| `CE` | Current exposure |
| `COLLATERAL_MODEL` | Collateral model |
| `CONFIDENCE` | Confidence |
| `EAD_IMM` | EAD (internal model, informational) |
| `EEPE` | EEPE |
| `EPE` | EPE |
| `FLAGS` | Flags |
| `MPOR_DAYS` | Margin period of risk (days) |
| `NOTE` | Note |
| `PATHS` | Paths |
| `PEAK_PFE` | Peak PFE |
| `PEAK_PFE_DATE` | Peak PFE date |
| `PROFILE[].DATE` | Date |
| `PROFILE[].EE` | EE |

Links: `RUN_ID` → `simulation-run`.

## Screens and commands

| Command | Kind | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| `AGR` | `agreement` | Master agreement |
| `CSA` | `csa` | Credit support annex |
| `NSET` | `netting-set` | Netting set |
| `LIM` | `credit-limit` | Credit limit |
| `CVA` | `cva` | CVA / XVA |
| `SACCR` | `sa-ccr` | SA-CCR exposure |
| `COLL` | `collateral-balance` | Collateral balance |
| `MC` | `margin-call` | Margin call |
| `SIMM` | `simm` | ISDA SIMM initial margin |
| `XRUN` | `simulation-run` | Exposure simulation run |
| `XPATH` | `exposure-path` | Exposure path (a trade's MtM on every path at a grid date) |
| `EXP` | `exposure-result` | Exposure profile of a scope (computed) |
| `XWIF` | `exposure-whatif` | Exposure what-if before dealing (computed, Python) |
| `XOFC` | `exposure-official-cpty` | Exposure official results by netting set and counterparty (published) |
| `CCR` | — | The pack's overview: its kinds, how many each holds, an example of each |

Examples:

| Type | Shows |
|---|---|
| `AGR AGR-NORTHBRIDGE-ISDA` | ISDA master agreement · elections |
| `NSET NS-ALDERSHOT-NY` | Netting set · its trades, the exposure computed from the paths, CVA |
| `LIM LIM-SUMMIT` | Credit limit · utilisation by tenor |
| `CVA CVA-SUMMIT-NY` | CVA / XVA |
| `SACCR SACCR-SUMMIT-NY` | SA-CCR exposure at default |
| `EXP NSET:NS-ALDERSHOT-FRA` | Exposure profile of a netting set · EE, PFE 95 and 99, EPE, EEPE computed from the paths |
| `EXP CPTY:CP-ALDERSHOT` | A counterparty's exposure · its four netting sets summed path by path (PFE is not a sum of PFEs) |

Screens (Sutras):

| Sutra | Kind | What it shows |
|---|---|---|
| `collateral-balance` | `collateral-balance` | Collateral held and posted under a CSA, by asset, after haircuts. |
| `csa` | `csa` | Collateral terms: thresholds, minimum transfer, eligible collateral and haircuts. |
| `margin-call` | `margin-call` | A variation or initial margin call and its settlement status. |
| `simm` | `simm` | Initial margin by risk class and product class. |
| `agreement` | `agreement` | ISDA, GMRA or GMSLA master agreement with its key elections. |
| `credit-limit` | `credit-limit` | PFE limit by tenor bucket for a counterparty, with utilisation. |
| `cva` | `cva` | Credit, debit and funding valuation adjustments with sensitivities. |
| `exposure-result` | `exposure-result` | The exposure profile of any counterparty scope (a netting set, a counterparty, a group, a legal entity, a trade alone), computed from the simulated paths. |
| `netting-set` | `netting-set` | Trades that net on close-out under one agreement and CSA, with exposure and collateral. |
| `sa-ccr` | `sa-ccr` | Regulatory EAD: replacement cost, PFE add-ons by asset class, multiplier. |

## Data sources and licences

| Source | Licence | Internal only | Used for |
|---|---|---|---|
| Synthetic sample data (tools/packgen/banking) | Proprietary (part of Drishti); fictitious names and figures | no | every document in samples/ and the demo lake |

Every kind's data contract (each column: type, key, example, links) and where its data comes from (an external source and its refresh script, a generator of synthetic data, or a Drishti engine) are in the guide, [guides/counterparty-risk.md](guides/counterparty-risk.md): *Data contracts* and *Data retrieval*.

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on the packs `trading`.

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `legal-store` | `delta` | `agreement`, `csa` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `credit-store` | `delta` | `netting-set`, `credit-limit`, `cva`, `sa-ccr` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `collateral-store` | `delta` | `collateral-balance`, `margin-call`, `simm` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `exposure-results` | `delta` | `exposure-official-cpty` | `${DRISHTI_EXPOSURE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `exposure-store` | `delta` | `simulation-run`, `exposure-path` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `exposure-engine` | `reactive` | `exposure-result` | `${DRISHTI_EXPOSURE_ENABLED:true}` |
| `exposure-whatif` | `reactive` | `exposure-whatif` | `${DRISHTI_EXPOSURE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_DELTA_ROOT`, `DRISHTI_EXPOSURE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`.

## Refreshing the data

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/banking/make_docs.py`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.
